sponsored.t: Establishes the 2-1-1 essential community services hotline system
sponsored.sum: Establishes the 2-1-1 essential community services hotline system; designates the office of children and family services to oversee the hotline system; establishes the availability and scope of information to be provided by the hotline system and requirements of call centers; requires the office of children and family services to collect certain data relating to the hotline system and to make annual reports to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain members of the United States Air Force Auxiliary Civil Air Patrol or the United States Coast Guard Auxiliary Pilots shall be granted leave from work with pay for air force assigned missions
sponsored.sum: Provides that public officers and employees of the state who are members of the United States Air Force Auxiliary Civil Air Patrol or the United States Coast Guard Auxiliary Pilots shall be granted leave from work with pay to participate in emergency services during certain air force assigned missions.

sponsored.t: Permits the Vestal Central School District to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Vestal Central School District to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Permits the Johnson City Central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Johnson City central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Provides for permitted leaves of absence for members of civil air patrol
sponsored.sum: Provides for permitted leaves of absence for members of the civil air patrol during emergencies for purposes of assisting with such emergencies.

sponsored.t: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits
sponsored.sum: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the inspection of certain vacated or abandoned properties for abandoned companion animals
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the inspection of property that has been vacated or abandoned for abandoned companion animals.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Johnson City to establish hotel and motel taxes within such village
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Johnson City to establish hotel and motel taxes within such village.

sponsored.t: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of deputy sheriff for the Broome county sheriff's office
sponsored.sum: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of deputy sheriff for the Broome county sheriff's office.

sponsored.t: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the Broome county department of personnel
sponsored.sum: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the Broome county department of personnel.

sponsored.t: Establishes the sports officials protection act establishing the crimes of assault on sports officials and aggravated harassment of a sports official
sponsored.sum: Establishes the sports officials protection act establishing the crimes of assault on sports officials and aggravated harassment of a sports official.

sponsored.t: Increases the state subsidy for school lunch meals
sponsored.sum: Increases the state subsidy for school lunch meals based on the percentage of breakfast service, lunch service and reimbursable snack program food purchased from New York state farmers, growers, producers or processors.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for sales or rentals of agricultural assets to emerging farmers; and establishes the duties of the commissioner of agriculture and markets with respect thereto
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for sales or rentals of agricultural assets to emerging farmers; requires the commissioner of agriculture and markets to implement a plan for certification of eligible taxpayers with respect thereto.

sponsored.t: Increases tax credits for donations to food pantries made by farmers
sponsored.sum: Increases tax credits for donations to food pantries made by farmers by increasing the allowable percentage of the fair market value of such donations and increasing the maximum amount of such credit.

sponsored.t: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists.

sponsored.t: Extends eligibility for the farm employer overtime tax credit
sponsored.sum: Extends eligibility for the farm employer overtime tax credit to certain professional employer organizations that are in a contractual relationship with an eligible farm employer.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property and services used in the cultivation of cannabis for adult-use from sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property and services used in the cultivation of cannabis for adult-use from sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department to issue special airport air strike hazard permits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to issue special airport air strike hazard permits when the department finds that wildlife has become a nuisance, destructive to public or private property or a threat to public health or welfare.

sponsored.t: Relates to limitations upon school district tax levies
sponsored.sum: Provides that the tax levy limit shall be equal to a zero percent increase over the prior year tax levy when the difference between the total amount of taxes levied for the prior year less the tax levy limit results in a negative number.

sponsored.t: Exempts farmers from commercial driver's license (CDL) requirements when operating a covered farm vehicle
sponsored.sum: Exempts farmers from commercial driver's license (CDL) requirements when operating a covered farm vehicle within one hundred fifty miles of such farmer's farm.

sponsored.t: Relates to school district unexpended surplus funds
sponsored.sum: Relates to school district unexpended surplus funds; provides that for the 2027--2028 school year and thereafter, surplus funds shall mean any operating funds in excess of six percent of the current school year budget, and shall not include funds properly retained under other sections of law.

sponsored.t: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of the advanced clean trucks regulations
sponsored.sum: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of the advanced clean trucks regulations by the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the agrivoltaics viability pilot program within the farmland viability program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the agrivoltaics viability pilot program to provide grants to identify the best practices and strategies for agrivoltaics and dual-use solar energy projects that protect soil health during construction and decommissioning of solar arrays, utilize sustainable agricultural production practices, monitor any benefits solar energy may have on farms and to the state, track economic viability, study the commercialization of dual-use solar energy projects, and encourage equitable engagement of stakeholders.

sponsored.t: Relates to motorcycle profiling
sponsored.sum: Requires the municipal police training council to ensure that issues related to motorcycle profiling are addressed in basic law enforcement training.

sponsored.t: Permits schools located within the state to provide or sell certain New York milk
sponsored.sum: Permits schools located within the state to purchase reduced fat or whole New York milk to provide or sell at such school; defines New York milk as raw milk produced by milking cows within the state, transported to a dairy processing center within the state, and processed as fluid milk into containers intended for distribution to consumers.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the veterinarians across rural New York state student loan repayment fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the veterinarians across rural New York state student loan repayment fund for certain veterinarians that make a two year commitment to practice in a tract or county defined by the health resources and services administration as being "rural" or eligible for a rural health grant.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Kevin Burns to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Kevin Burns to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan for service with the Binghamton Fire Department.

sponsored.t: Authorizes retail dispensary licensees, microbusiness licensees and nursery licensees to sell up to three immature cannabis plants per person for personal cultivation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes retail dispensary licensees, microbusiness licensees and nursery licensees to sell up to three immature cannabis plants per person for personal cultivation; defines immature cannabis plant; directs the cannabis control board to promulgate rules and regulations relating to the sale of immature cannabis plants.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Scott Pavlick to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Scott Pavlick to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan offering one-sixtieths after twenty-five years of total creditable service for service with the Binghamton Fire Department.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enactment of the student journalism education act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the student journalist education act to protect student speech at educational institutions unless such speech is libelous, an invasion of privacy, or incites students to commit an unlawful act, violate school policies, or to materially and substantially disrupt the orderly operation of the school.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program to provide students with the opportunity to be educated on the agricultural industry and alternative career paths and to provide agricultural work experience and entrepreneurship work experience.

sponsored.t: Establishes radon measurement license and radon mitigation license requirements
sponsored.sum: Establishes radon measurement license and radon mitigation license requirements; defines terms; establishes powers and duties of the department of labor and of licensees with regards to such licenses; establishes penalties; establishes the radon mitigation and control fund.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state kratom consumer protection act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the New York state kratom consumer protection act; relates to labeling and other requirements for the sale of kratom products.

sponsored.t: Establishes the small cannabis farmer relief act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "small cannabis farmer relief act" to allow certain cultivators to expand their canopy.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of three-wheeled vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to the operation of three-wheeled vehicles; removes requirement that such vehicles have two wheels situated in the front and one wheel in the rear.

sponsored.t: Relates to the manufacture and sale of slushies made with liquor, wine, beer or cider
sponsored.sum: Relates to the manufacture and sale of slushies made with liquor, wine, beer or cider; includes slushies as frozen desserts.

sponsored.t: Removes emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments
sponsored.sum: Removes expenditures for emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 121 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 2177-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, in relation to removing emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments" NOT APPROVED This bill would exclude the costs of Emergency Medical Services from the calculation of the limit upon municipal property tax levy increases imposed by the General Municipal Law. The property tax cap, enacted in 2011, restricts the annual increase in local property tax levies by local governments and school districts to two percent or the rate of inflation, whichever is less. The tax cap has been effective in limiting local property tax growth, resulting in considerable savings for taxpayers. This bill, as written, could lead to substantially higher property taxes imposed on…

sponsored.t: Establishes a brand owner's license
sponsored.sum: Allows a person with a federal basic permit to apply to the liquor authority for a brand owner's license; establishes a fee therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to continuing education requirements for landscape architects
sponsored.sum: Relates to continuing education requirements for landscape architects; provides that adjustments to such requirements may be granted for health reasons, active duty, or other good cause; limits the number of credit hours that may carry over to the next registration period.

sponsored.t: Authorizes David Edwards to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes David Edwards to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan offering one-sixtieths after twenty-five years of total creditable service for service with the Binghamton Fire Department.

sponsored.t: Defines therapeutic agriculture for the purposes of community gardens
sponsored.sum: Defines therapeutic agriculture for the purposes of community gardens as the use of agricultural activities as a means of promoting physical, mental and emotional well-being, rehabilitation and therapy for certain individuals.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 39 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 2185, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to defining therapeutic agriculture for purposes of community gardens" NOT APPROVED This bill would add a definition of "therapeutic agriculture" into Article 2-C of the Agriculture and Markets (AGM) Law regarding community gardens. I recognize the physical and mental health benefits that community gardening can bring, including for individuals with physical or mental health conditions, disabilities, or other special needs. However, the definition of therapeutic agriculture proposed in this bill is broad, and its impact on existing or future programs is not clear from the bill text. This could lead to unintended consequences and an administrative burden on the Department of Agriculture…

sponsored.t: Exempts processors of syrup made from tree sap or honey from certain licensing requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts processors of syrup made from tree sap or honey who do not purchase syrup made from tree sap or honey from others for repackaging, and who do not combine syrup made from tree sap or honey with any other ingredients capable of supporting the growth of infectious or toxigenic organisms from certain licensing requirements for food processing establishments.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timeframe for distributors of cannabis products to file tax returns
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timeframe for distributors of cannabis products to file tax returns.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Broome to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Broome to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes for two years.

sponsored.t: Relates to types of New York grown, produced or harvested milk products included in the definition of surplus agricultural products for the purposes of the Nourish New York program
sponsored.sum: Relates to types of New York grown, produced or harvested milk products included in the definition of surplus agricultural products for the purposes of the Nourish New York program; directs that such term include New York grown, produced or harvested milk, and milk products, including but not limited to two percent fat milk and whole milk.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products to include cannabis
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products to include cannabis when cultivated in accordance with the cannabis law; amends the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to cannabis showcase event permits
sponsored.sum: Sets forth certain provisions for the sale of adult-use cannabis and adult-use cannabis products at cannabis showcase events; requires permittees to partner with cultivators in certain situations.
